Name Fox-1C (Fox 1Cliff, AO-95)
Form factor CubeSat
Units or mass 1U
Status Semi-operational, beacons being received, but no uplink (Last SatNOGS report with data 2023-06-09 last checked 2013-06-10)
Launched 2018-12-03
NORAD ID 43770
Deployer QuadPack (XL) [ISISpace],?
Launcher Falcon 9 (Spaceflight SSO-A, SHERPA)
Entity name The Radio Amateur Satellite Corporation (AMSAT)
Institution Company
Entity Commercial
Nation US
Launch brokerer Spaceflight
Partners Virginia Tech, Vanderbilt University
Oneliner

FM repeater, camera and radiation experiment.
Description

Fox-1Cliff and Fox-1D will carry the same FM repeater as Fox-1A (AO-85), in addition to a Virginia Tech camera experiment that will take images of Earth for high-speed downlink. Fox-1Cliff will also contain a radiation experiment from Vanderbilt University ISDE, like the one in AO-85.
Failure cause Anomaly with her receive capability.
